windows-xinput-observation-01.json.verbatim: When I connect it to Windows, I get the first ding sound and it shows as Pico with a generic icon in Other devices. Then after the bootscreen completes, the PC dings a sounds again, showing the initial Pico disappearing and a new Pico named device appearing. It still shows as Other devices, but the symbol is a gamepad. So it is not being read as an Input Device still.
